Class SudokuModel

java.lang.Object
com.project.sudokugame.SudokuModel
public class SudokuModel extends Object
Represents the model component of the Sudoku game (6x6 version).

This class stores both the complete solution and the current puzzle state. It handles solution generation using backtracking, random puzzle creation, and hint management for the user.

Empty cells in the puzzle are represented by 0.

    • generateNewPuzzle

      public void generateNewPuzzle()
      Creates a new puzzle by generating a valid solution and removing random cells.

      The number of clues kept varies randomly between 10 and 18, defining a medium difficulty level.

      Note: this implementation does not ensure uniqueness of the generated puzzle.

    • giveHint

      public int[] giveHint()
      Provides a hint by filling one random empty cell with the correct solution value.
      Returns:
      an array [row, col, value] of the filled cell, or null if there are no empty cells left.
